theorem LocallyCompactBaire.exists_maximal_pairwiseDisjoint_refinement.{u, v} {X : Type u} {α : Type v} (f : α → Set X)
  (P : α → Prop) :
  Exists fun F =>
    And (∀ (a : α), Membership.mem F a → P a)
      (And (Set.PairwiseDisjoint F f)
        (∀ (F' : Set α), (∀ (a : α), Membership.mem F' a → P a) → Set.PairwiseDisjoint F' f → LE.le F F' → LE.le F' F))

theorem LocallyCompactBaire.exists_pairwiseDisjoint_dense_refinement.{u, v} {X : Type u} {α : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
  (f : α → Set X) (P : α → Prop) {G : Set X} (hG : IsOpen G)
  (hP : ∀ (a : α), P a → And (IsOpen (f a)) (And (Set.Nonempty (f a)) (LE.le (f a) G)))
  (hrefine : ∀ (W : Set X), IsOpen W → Set.Nonempty W → LE.le W G → Exists fun a => And (P a) (LE.le (f a) W)) :
  Exists fun F =>
    And (∀ (a : α), Membership.mem F a → P a)
      (And (Set.PairwiseDisjoint F f)
        (And (LE.le (Set.iUnion fun a => Set.iUnion fun h => f a) G)
          (LE.le G (closure (Set.iUnion fun a => Set.iUnion fun h => f a)))))
audit_declarations.name: LocallyCompactBaire.exists_pairwiseDisjoint_dense_refinement

theorem LocallyCompactBaire.exists_dense_isGdelta_fiber_witness.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [TopologicalSpace X]
  [TopologicalSpace Y] [BaireSpace X] [R1Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y] (D : Nat → Set (Prod X Y))
  (hDo : ∀ (n : Nat), IsOpen (D n)) (hDd : ∀ (n : Nat), Dense (D n)) {V : Set Y} (hVo : IsOpen V)
  (hVn : Set.Nonempty V) :
  Exists fun G =>
    And (IsGδ G)
      (And (Dense G)
        (∀ (x : X),
          Membership.mem G x →
            Exists fun y => And (Membership.mem V y) (∀ (n : Nat), Membership.mem (D n) (Prod.mk x y))))
